items.caption:
Who else is guilty for number 3? Walking past your dishwasher multiple times a day hoping it will miraculously empty itself? 🙈

I started cleaning and somehow ended up deep cleaning the tops of my kitchen cupboards… a job I’d been putting off for 5 MONTHS because my brain had convinced me it would take forever.

So I timed it: 10 minutes 14 seconds. 😳

Then the toaster I’d been putting off for 3 months: 4 minutes 8 seconds.

And finally, the dishwasher I apparently expect to magically empty itself all day? 2 minutes 35 seconds. 😂

Proof that the jobs we put off rarely take as long as our brains tell us they will!

What are you guilty of ignoring? 👀

I can’t believe we’re in August already! Here are 5 of your favourite home hacks of 2026 so far ✨

1. ☀️ Break down stubborn suncream stains by soaking them in citric acid before washing as normal with a scoop of Napisan or Oxi Action. Use white vinegar in place of fabric softener to help lift any lingering odours and residue.
2. 🏷️ Remove stubborn stickers with a hairdryer. The heat softens the adhesive and makes them much easier to peel away. If there’s any sticky residue left behind, a little nail varnish remover can help dissolve it.
3. ☕️ Whiten caffeine-stained mugs with a denture tablet. Just pop one into the mug with hot water, leave it to work, then rinse thoroughly.
4. 🚿 Denture tablets aren’t just for dentures! They can also help freshen up your drains. Pop one on the drain cover or down the drain if there isn’t a cover, add some hot water and let it fizz away.
5. 🧼 Use your mop for more than just floors! A mop can make cleaning larger surfaces like baths, shower trays, tiles and even windows much quicker. Just remember to use separate mop heads for different areas!

Which one is your favourite? 👇

My DMs have been busy with requests about this, so here’s 4 DIY fly repellent hacks I’ve found online that are definitely worth trying 🪰✨

1. Fill a saucepan halfway with water, add 1 sliced lemon, 1–2 sprigs of rosemary, 10–20 cloves and 10–20 drops of lemongrass essential oil. Bring to the boil, then simmer. Top up the water as and when needed — refresh every couple of days when the scent starts to fade.
2. Sprinkle cinnamon around the base and inside the lid of your bins to help deter flies from hanging around those unwanted smells 🗑️
3. Add cloves to half a lemon and place it in your fruit bowl to help keep fruit flies away 🍋
4. Place mint near an open window to help discourage flies from coming in 🌿

Which one will you try first? 👇
.
